# Receipt Protocol — Software Engineer

The full schema and required fields live in the shared
`protocols/receipt-protocol.md`, which is auto-injected into your
SubagentStart `additional_context`. This file is the SE-specific
checklist.

## Before you stop

1. Do all your work (write code, run tests, generate artefacts).
2. Verify outputs exist (`test -s <path>`, exit-code checks).
3. **Write the receipt** to:

   ```
   .synaptory/.orchestrator/receipts/{story_id}-se.json
   ```

   Use the canonical short code `se`. Do **not** use the full role
   name (`software-engineer`) or append a timestamp — the
   SubagentStop verify hook and `collect_story_receipts()` only
   recognise `{story_id}-se.json`.

4. THEN call `TaskUpdate(status="completed")`.

## Required fields for SE

In addition to the shared schema:

- `role` — `"software-engineer"`
- `token_usage.stage` — `"se-implementation"`
- `story_dod` — flip each boolean from your verification results
  (`tests_pass`, `build_succeeds`, `coverage_no_decrease`,
  `no_critical_findings`).
- `verification_commands` — at minimum one command per artefact
  (e.g. `test -s src/feature.ts`, `npm test -- --bail`).

## Anti-patterns the hook will reject

- ❌ `HT-350-software-engineer-20260512T0830Z.json` — improvised filename
- ❌ Receipt JSON emitted only in your response text (no `Write` call)
- ❌ `TaskUpdate(completed)` before the receipt file exists

If the receipt file is missing when SubagentStop runs, the verify hook
will log `receipt_missing` and the pipeline will block in
Autonomous engagement mode.
